bear_assumptions: FY2028 revenue USD 488.75m from 15% growth on the USD 425m guidance low; 7x EV/revenue, USD 150m net cash and 390m diluted shares as RPO conversion, margins and cash burn weaken.
base_assumptions: FY2028 revenue USD 541.25m from 25% growth on the USD 433m guidance midpoint; 10x EV/revenue, USD 250m net cash and 380m diluted shares as retention and margins broadly hold while dilution continues.
bull_assumptions: FY2028 revenue USD 594m from 35% growth on the USD 440m guidance high; 16x EV/revenue, USD 350m net cash and 370m diluted shares as RPO converts, margins and cash generation improve, and dilution is contained.
rating_change_conditions: Reassess after Q2 results or any material change in revenue growth, RPO conversion, retention, gross margin, free cash flow, satellite reliability, government funding, guidance, net cash or diluted share count; upgrade only if a fresh scenario valuation clears the canonical expected-return, base-return, payoff and margin-of-safety gates.
